source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Match each stomach secretion or action to its function: churning, protein breakdown, killing bacteria, and protecting the lining.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Mucus breaks proteins into simpler components.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Stomach acid normally damages the stomach lining.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The stomach lining protects mucus from acid.

intelligence.enrichment: In the stomach, wall movements churn food and mix it with secretions; stomach digestive juice breaks proteins into simpler components, acid helps break down proteins and kills many harmful bacteria, and mucus protects the stomach lining from acid. stomach churning and secretions act on food -> proteins are partly digested, many bacteria are killed, and the stomach lining is protected The learner correctly applies this rule: In the stomach, wall movements churn food and mix it with secretions; stomach digestive juice breaks proteins into simpler components, acid helps break down proteins and kills many harmful bacteria, and mucus protects the stomach lining from acid. The stomach is only a storage bag where food waits before going to the intestine.
